prompt: # CODING PROMPT — "RAW GRID" NEO-BRUTALIST LANDING PAGE **Role:** You are a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Build the complete landing page on the first attempt. Every rule below is mandatory. Deliver production-quality, accessible, responsive code — no drafts, no apologies, no lorem ipsum. --- ## 0. THEME DEFINITION — "RAW GRID" - **Style:** Neo-Brutalist, Scrappy, Graphic, Direct (2020s Neo-Brutalism) - **Keywords:** thick borders, pink offset shadows, sage accents, dense grid, compact spacing, no-nonsense copy - **Global Aesthetic Laws (apply to every component):** - Every surface and interactive element carries a hard `3px solid` border. No soft blurs, no gradients, no glassmorphism. - Shadows are hard-edged solid offsets, never blurred: `box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #F472B6` (primary pink) and `3px 3px 0` black ink (secondary/small elements). - Sharp corners by default (`--radius-sm: 0`). - Hover = bold color shift at 150ms. Active/pressed = element translates INTO its shadow (shadow collapses to `0 0 0`, element moves by the offset). High-contrast, tactile, graphic-confident. - Dense rhythm: compact `1.2rem` gaps, tight typography, grid-line texture in the hero (CSS gradients only — never images). - **No raster images anywhere.** All visuals are built from CSS: borders, tints, offset shadows, chips, and Google Material Symbols icons. --- ## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE **1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS** - All styling lives in `style.css`. **The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden in the HTML.** - Target everything via class/ID selectors only. - HTML stays semantic and styling-agnostic (`header`, `main`, `section`, `footer`, `h1`–`h3`, `nav`, `button`, `label`, `input`); reskinning the site must require CSS edits only. **1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens** Define all visual tokens in `:root`. Exact values: ```css :root { /* Action & ink */ --primary: #111111; /* borders, button ink, black offset shadows */ --secondary: #F472B6; /* hard pink accent: offset shadows, highlights */ /* Surfaces */ --bg-primary: #FAFAFA; /* page background — never #ffffff */ --bg-secondary: #FEFEFE; /* card surfaces */ --bg-tertiary: #F5F5F5; /* gray chips, badges, meta strips */ /* Text */ --text-primary: #0A0A0A; --text-secondary: #555555; --text-success: #2F6B3F; --text-error: #D7263D; /* Tints */ --pink-tint: #F2D4CF; /* soft pink panels — dark text only */ --sage: #86A882; /* sage accent: borders, icons, chips */ --sage-tint: #E5EDD6; /* soft sage panels — dark text only */ /* Borders (full shorthand) */ --border-default: 3px solid #111111; --border-error: 3px solid #D7263D; --border-success: 3px solid #2F6B3F; /* Shape & depth */ --radius-sm: 0; --radius-md: 2px; --radius-lg: 4px; --shadow-sm: 3px 3px 0 #111111; /* small elements: black offset */ --shadow-md: 5px 5px 0 #F472B6; /* primary components: pink offset */ /* Rhythm & motion */ --spacing-gap: 1.2rem; --transition-fast: 120ms; --transition-normal: 150ms; --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); /* Type */ --font-base: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; /* Stacking */ --z-dropdown: 100; --z-modal: 200; --z-toast: 300; } ``` - **Contrast Pairing (enforced in every theme, not just default):** light surfaces (`#FAFAFA`, `#FEFEFE`, `#F5F5F5`, `--pink-tint`, `--sage-tint`) pair only with `--text-primary` dark text; dark/ink surfaces pair only with `--text-primary` light text. `--secondary` (#F472B6) and `--sage` (#86A882) are **never** used as backgrounds behind body text — they are reserved for borders, offset shadows, icons, and chips. **1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode** - **Exception note:** the source style spec lists dark mode as "None"; the mandatory dark-mode rule overrides this — dark mode must ship, styled as an inverted ink-on-paper variant of Raw Grid. - Define dark tokens under both `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and a `.dark` class on `` (class takes precedence when applied): ```css --primary: #FAFAFA; --bg-primary: #0A0A0A; --bg-secondary: #161616; --bg-tertiary: #212121; --text-primary: #FAFAFA; --text-secondary: #A6A6A6; --text-success: #7FC98B; --text-error: #FF6B7E; --pink-tint: #3B2530; /* light text only */ --sage: #9DBE99; --sage-tint: #252F26; /* light text only */ --border-default: 3px solid #FAFAFA; --border-error: 3px solid #FF6B7E; --border-success: 3px solid #7FC98B; --shadow-sm: 3px 3px 0 #FAFAFA; --shadow-md: 5px 5px 0 #F472B6; /* pink stays — it pops on ink */ ``` - Background and text variables must flip seamlessly with **zero HTML restructuring**. Primary buttons invert automatically (light surface, dark text) because they are driven by tokens. - **Toggle control:** a visible `.theme-toggle` button in the header with a Google Material Symbols icon (`dark_mode` / `light_mode`), correct `aria-pressed` state, and a dynamic `aria-label` ("Switch to dark theme" / "Switch to light theme"). - **Persistence:** store the choice in `localStorage`; on first visit fall back to `prefers-color-scheme`. - **Exception clause:** one minimal inline theme-bootstrap `` before ``, plus the single permitted theme-bootstrap line in `` (Section 1.3 exception). Google Fonts ``s in ``. - **Naming:** strict BEM (`block__element--modifier`) across the entire deliverable — never mix conventions. - **Copy:** author all user-facing copy yourself, in **English**, in the Raw Grid voice — scrappy, direct, confident, zero fluff. Short declarative sentences. Punchy, benefit-led headlines (tone anchor: "Work fast. Ship loud."). Realistic testimonial quotes with first name + role, plausible pricing numbers, 4–5 genuine FAQ questions with 2–3 sentence answers. **No lorem ipsum anywhere.** - **Placeholders:** the only permitted `href="#"` placeholders are the footer's secondary links to pages that don't exist (About, Careers, Privacy, Terms); anchor links to on-page sections must use real IDs. - **Product identity:** invent one short, punchy product name and use it consistently across header wordmark, hero, footer, and copy. --- ## 5. PAGE SECTION SPECIFICATION (Build in This Order) **5.1 Header (slim, sticky):** skip-link, then a flex bar (`align-items: center`, `justify-content: space-between`): bordered wordmark chip, anchor links to `#features`, `#how`, `#pricing`, `#faq` (hidden below 768px via media query — no JS menu), and the `.theme-toggle` at the right. `border-bottom: var(--border-default)`, background `--bg-primary`, z-index `--z-dropdown`. **5.2 Hero:** dense CSS grid-line texture background; mobile: flex column; desktop: two-part flex row. One `h1` in Space Grotesk 700 with one word wrapped in `.highlight` (pink-tint background, 3px border, slight rotate for the scrappy feel). Direct subhead (1–2 sentences). CTA row: `.btn--primary` + `.btn--secondary`. A proof strip with `check` icons. Right side: a CSS-built graphic — a cluster of bordered stat/label chips with pink and black offset shadows. **5.3 Features (3 cards):** kicker chip + `h2`; flex-wrap row of three equal `.card`s (1-up mobile, 3-up ≥ 768px), each with a Material Symbol icon in a bordered sage-tint badge, `h3`, direct description, and a "Learn more" text link with icon — demonstrating card hover and `:focus-within`. **5.4 How It Works (3 steps):** three bordered step cards with oversized Space Grotesk numerals ("01", "02", "03") in pink/sage bordered chips, icon, title, short copy. Flex column mobile, row desktop, connected by a CSS pseudo-element rule line on desktop. **5.5 Testimonials:** three non-interactive `.card`s — `format_quote` icon, quote copy, and an author row: bordered initials chip (alternating pink/sage tints), name, role. **5.6 Pricing (3 tiers):** flex row of three `.card`s. Middle tier `.card--featured`: `--pink-tint` background, `--shadow-md` pink offset, a rotated (-2deg) "MOST POPULAR" badge chip, larger padding, and `.btn--primary`; side tiers use `.btn--secondary`. Each tier: name, big price, 3–4 list items with `check` icons. **Do not add a monthly/yearly toggle — it was not requested.** **5.7 FAQ:** bordered container stack with `var(--spacing-gap)` gaps; 4–5 accordion items per Section 2.5; first item open. **5.8 Final CTA:** high-impact panel — `--pink-tint` background, 3px border, `--shadow-md`; `h2`, one direct line, and the email capture `.input-group` (per Section 2.3) with a `.btn--primary` submit. On submit: validate → invalid shows `.form-error` in `--text-error` with `aria-live` announcement → valid shows `.btn--loading` (800ms) → `.btn--success` with a confirmation message in the live region. This front-end demo lives in `script.js`. **5.9 Footer with secondary links:** `border-top: var(--border-default)`. Flex-wrap columns: wordmark + one-liner; "Product" group (real anchors to Features, Pricing, FAQ); "Company" group (About, Careers, Contact — `href="#"` permitted); "Legal" group (Privacy, Terms). Bottom bar: © 2025 + product name, "Back to top" link. No newsletter form here — the capture already lives in 5.8. **5.10 `script.js` scope (nothing more):** theme bootstrap/toggle with `localStorage`; FAQ accordion; CTA form demo. No other JavaScript. --- ## 6. ACCEPTANCE CHECKLIST (verify before submitting) - Zero inline `style` attributes; zero inline SVGs; icons are Material Symbols only. - Dark mode fully functional: toggle works, `aria-pressed` correct, choice persists across reloads, correct `prefers-color-scheme` fallback, no theme flash. - Every `.btn` state exists: hover, active press-into-shadow, focus ring, loading, disabled, success, error, danger. - Cards show hover/focus-within where interactive; skeleton and empty-state classes ship. - Full keyboard walkthrough succeeds: skip-link → toggle → anchors → CTAs → FAQ → form, with visible focus everywhere. - No horizontal scroll at 320px; reduced-motion respected; contrast verified in both themes. - BEM naming consistent end to end; copy in English, on-voice, lorem-ipsum-free; three files, one deferred script.
